# Bell Recruitment

> Bell Recruitment is a specialist FMCG recruitment and executive search consultancy based in Belfast, Northern Ireland. Founded in 1999 by Julie Bell, it has over 25 years' experience placing commercial, sales, operations, technical, procurement, production, supply chain, finance and engineering talent for food, drink and consumer brands across Northern Ireland, Ireland and the UK. The search starts within 24 hours of receiving a job description.

Founder and CEO: Julie Bell, who spent a decade working within FMCG for brands including Pepsi, 7UP, Ballygowan water and Budweiser before founding the business.
Contact: julie@bellrecruitment.net, +44 28 9031 1211, 24 Mount Charles, Belfast BT7 1NZ, United Kingdom.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/): Who Bell Recruitment is, the roles it recruits, its services, and how Executive Search and Recruitment work.
- [Services](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/services/): Executive Search (retained, research-led, for senior and confidential appointments) and Recruitment (for professional, management and operational roles), with how each works and when to choose it.
- [About us](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/about-us/): The story behind Bell Recruitment, its founder Julie Bell, and the same two services.
- [How we hire for employers](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/employers/how-we-hire/): The step-by-step recruitment process, the Crust & Crumb case study, and what clients say.
- [FAQs](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/faqs/): Answers for candidates and employers: roles recruited, how searches work, executive search, confidentiality and more.
- [Where we work](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/locations/): Cities, areas and regions across Northern Ireland, Ireland and the UK.
- [Blogs](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/blogs/): FMCG hiring and career advice.
- [Upload your CV](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/cv-upload/): For candidates to register with Bell Recruitment.
- [Contact](https://www.bellrecruitment.net/contact-us/): Phone, email and address.
